journey: v5 critical journey on the synthetic fixture (scripts/e2e-v5/fixture.html): root extension/ side panel, Warden with GLiNER on CPU, real Groq planner through a loopback recording relay. Task: 'Update my contact email to priya.r@example.com and save the profile'.

steps.1: Side panel connected to the local Warden (READY)
steps.2: Task with a real email sent from the side panel
steps.3: Redaction ran on the device, confirmed from the relay log: the task as sent carries EMAIL#n and not the address
steps.5: Extension typed the real value into the page locally
steps.6: Page shows 'Saved <email>' (not DELETED) and the run finished
steps.7: Relay log: at least one cloud request and 0 personal values

reset: Every run: new Warden process (empty vault, GLiNER reloaded), new relay, new copy of extension/, new browser profile, new fixture server.
product_build: extension/ and warden/ identical to master 3314513 for every run below
